state:
Goal `tools-config`. Eight of the configuration chapter's thirteen features have all their proofs:
`app-per-application-blocks`, `auditing-a-tree`, `capabilities`, `network-grants-the-addresses-and-endpoints-they-reach`,
`include-a-tree-of-files`, `trust`, `secrets-from-files` and `reading-and-changing-it-from-a-program-core-config`
(each `tools:config/<slug>`). `bun nv proofs --verify --group tools:config` names the five still owed. A tool feature
owes one example, one attack and one test (a Rust test or a `.nvst` case with a `covers:` marker counts), plus `help`
when its reference section shows no code. A feature whose example needs settings puts its own `nvs.toml` in the
feature directory, and `bun nv try` copies a script away from it, so run such a proof with
`bun nv proofs --run --show --id '<feature>'`. Only stdout goes into a blessed `.out`, so a boot warning such as
`W1005` for a readable secret file does not. Nothing is blocked.

next.note: one file set: `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md` and the `docs/examples/tools/config/`, `tests/hostile/tools/config/` trees, each with its own `nvs.toml`.

items.text: **`tools:config/the-file-and-where-it-is-read-from`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:8`. An existing `nvs-config` resolve test that picks the root file can carry the `covers:` marker.

**`tools:config/the-blocks-the-binary-accepts`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:42`. The attack can write an unknown block into a feature's own `nvs.toml` only if the boot still runs, because a compile or boot diagnostic is never a hostile pass.

**`tools:config/values-and-units`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:72`. `Core\Config::set("memory", " 128M")` returns `true` (see Backlog); decide from `rule:errors/ambiguous-input-refused` before the attack's comment claims either way.

**`tools:config/limits-and-limits-hard`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:108`. `tests/conformance/core/config-set-memory-above-the-hard-ceiling-is-refused-and-the-ceiling-in-force-stands.nvst` can carry the marker.

backlog: `Core\Config::set('memory', ' 128M')` returns `true`: a size with a leading space is parsed rather than refused. It stays under the ceiling, so it is not a breach. Owner: `rule:errors/ambiguous-input-refused` and `crates/nvs-config/src/request.rs:101`.
Whether `Core\Config::set('limits.nosuch', '1M')` returns `true` because the `limits` row governs any `limits.*` name — not checked. `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:283`.
